note: Black Sea merchant ship attacks, 2026, seed list from media only. IMO publishes no per-ship list for the Black Sea. Only vessels with a name are included; unnamed strikes (e.g. 14 Oct near Mykolaiv and Chornomorsk, single X post) are omitted. Oct 2026 Alfa Watan (Togo) and Able (Palau) have no date in the source.

items.description: Hit by Russian missiles on or about 19 Jul; sinking reported 27 Jul. Nine crew and a Ukrainian harbour pilot reportedly died; weapon struck the bridge. Date approximate.
items.goldRef: Euromaidan Press 2026-10-16 and news reports (secondary; attribution and casualty figures not independently verified)

items.description: Bulk carrier bound Izmail to Ravenna with Ukrainian grain; attacked by Russian sea and air drones. Reported as sunk in article text, partially sunk in photo caption.

items.description: Reported sunk by drones; at least 17 seafarers missing. Romanian president blamed Russia in general terms; no attacker confirmed. Source gives date range only.
